resources.string: Sets the language of the app UI. \"System\" follows your device language; unsupported languages fall back to English.
Used for the colors of the list and settings screens, and as the initial theme when adding a repository.
Applies to the body text size of rendered Markdown and code views.
Appearance of file-extension icons in the list. Material/VS Code are full color; Seti is monochrome glyphs.
How long names are handled. Wrap = full text over multiple lines. Middle ellipsis = keep the start and end. End ellipsis = trim the end with ….
Combine chains that have only one child folder into a single entry like src/main/java, saving taps.
Shows each file/folder\'s last update (author and when) under its name in the list. It walks history, so it may take a little time in large repositories.
When you open a repository, restores the folder you were in and the file you had open. When off, it always opens at the top with no file open.
Initial state when opening a code/raw view. Off scrolls horizontally.
Initial state when opening a diff view for changes, commits, and history. Off scrolls horizontally.
Adds a line number to each line in code/text/raw views.
Opens viewers with body text selectable for copying. You can also toggle it per viewer from ⋮. While on, long-press to add a memo is disabled.
In rendered Markdown, sticks the current heading path (h1 > h2 > h3 …) to the top.
Inline = wrapped and embedded in the body (default). Scrollable = a table with a fixed header and horizontal scrolling.
Whether to open http/https links in the in-app browser (Custom Tabs) or an external browser. Relative links always navigate in-app.
Registered repositories: %1$d (including clone data and saved tokens)
This permanently deletes all %1$d registered repositories (clone data and saved tokens). It cannot be undone.
